title: Loggia gallery a body above the yard
what: A ring corridor 4.5 m wide runs round the whole building with its floor 1.93 bodies above the yard grass. Its inner side is open to the yard over a plain brick lower wall: from the yard you look up and see the gallery's tiled ceiling running along the top of the wall, so the gallery reads as a balcony and anyone in it holds the high ground over the yard. Midway along, a framed bay with two arched skull-filled windows and pilasters breaks the run and marks where the power-up (guns akimbo) is kept above. The east gallery opens to the sky in two bays.
recipe: Gallery sector 60: 2560 wide (4.5 m), 52 m long, floor z -12288, ceiling -45056 (1.93 bodies), floor tile 427, ceiling tile 491, walls 91/92/94. Yard floor z 20480, so the gallery floor is 32768 z (1.93 bodies) above the grass; the shared wall is a portal with only a lower wall of brick. Central bay: sectors 29/30 (1024 x 1024 each) on the yard side, floor 15360, open sky, wall art of arched skull windows. East gallery: sectors 38 and 40 have parallax ceilings (sky bays) between roofed lengths 37/39/41.
use: Saloon: an upper gallery on three sides of the bar room, a body and a half up, open over the floor. Arcade of shops: a first-floor walkway overlooking the shopping street. Theatre: the dress circle.
